decision.prediction: After accounting for input history, rebound timing will recur at similar elapsed times across different interventions.

mapping.target_relation: Elapsed-time forcing remains plausible, but observations do not distinguish it from input-driven history.
mapping.condition_to_check: Rebounds that shift with input history rather than elapsed time would weaken the clock account.
